notes: Caveats: the Aider Polyglot leaderboard covers six languages (225 exercises); our polyglot suite covers the same six languages (225 exercises); a run restricted with --lang covers a subset and is not directly comparable. Qwen model-card numbers are vendor-reported, with vendor-chosen harnesses (the Qwen3.8 card used the Claude Code harness for SWE-bench Pro, DeepSWE and NL2Repo). Stencil's edit benchmark uses 180 React files with its own harness; ours applies the same methodology to TypeScript/React, Python and Rust files. little-coder numbers are self-reported single runs. mini-SWE-agent numbers are SWE-bench Verified (bash-only), a different task set from every suite here. Collected 2026-10-14 from the linked pages.
